heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear and chilly. Areas of dense valley fog. Lows in the 40s, near 50 along Lake Champlain. Wind diminishing to light and variable.

heading: Saturday
text: Areas of dense valley fog burning off by mid-morning to sunny skies. Increasing clouds in the afternoon. Highs in the low to mid 70s. Light wind, becoming south near 10 mph, strong gusts possible over Lake Champlain.

heading: Saturday Night
text: Periods of clouds, becoming mostly cloudy overnight with an increasing chance of rain showers. Lows in the 50s east, upper 50s to low 60s west. South wind near 10 mph, gusting to 25 mph in the Champlain Valley.
